Keep a current skill and realistic backup alive during preparation.
IAS and IPS carry the strongest prestige association in Indian government service, and that reputation is earned by the selection rate and the policy-level responsibility that comes with the role.
What gets left out of most "central is more prestigious" framing is that this description applies mainly to the very top of central recruitment, not to every central government job.

A senior State Civil Service officer with a decade of strong district-level postings usually carries more real administrative authority, local influence, and promotion-track credibility than a mid-level central Group C employee.

items.text: A pay chart or a prestige ranking cannot tell you which track fits your actual life situation.
A state civil service post keeps you inside one state for your entire career, with district-to-district transfers you can often anticipate and sometimes influence.
The real difference is the state boundary, not zero movement.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: State PSC vs UPSC/SSC: the real exam map

rows: Recruiting body

Each state runs its own State Public Service Commission (UPPSC, BPSC, MPPSC, MPSC, and so on) for the state civil service, plus separate state boards for state police, state judicial and other departmental posts.
UPSC conducts the Civil Services Examination for IAS, IPS, IFoS, and central Group A services. SSC conducts CGL, CHSL, and other exams for Group B and C posts across central departments.
What you actually join
A state cadre such as UP PCS, Bihar PCS, or MP State Service, you serve inside that one state's administrative machinery for your entire career.

IAS/IPS/IFoS officers get allotted to one state cadre through UPSC but remain part of an all-India service; central Group A/B/C posts sit inside a ministry or department that operates offices across the country.
Number of exams to track
One state exam calendar to follow, usually annual, with a preliminary, mains, and interview stage similar in structure to UPSC.
UPSC CSE runs once a year; SSC runs several separate exams (CGL, CHSL, CPO, JE) each with its own calendar, so a central-only aspirant often tracks more than one notification cycle in parallel.

blocks.heading: Compare the Practical Paths
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Pay scale: 7th CPC vs state pay commissions

rows: Central government (7th CPC, Group B/C entry)

The 7th CPC pay matrix runs from Level 1 to Level 18, with a minimum central pay of Rs 18,000 a month at Level 1 and most Group B/C entry posts (SSC CGL, CHSL) sitting between Level 4 and Level 7. Dearness Allowance is revised twice a year on a fixed central schedule.
IAS/IPS and central Group A services

These start higher up the same 7th CPC matrix (commonly Level 10 at entry), with structured time-bound promotions through the matrix as officers gain seniority, on top of allowances tied to the post and posting location.
State civil service and state Group B/C posts

Most states adopted pay structures broadly aligned with the 7th CPC framework after 2016, but fitment factor, minimum pay, HRA, and DA rates are each state's own decision, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Odisha, and others have all set slightly different numbers, and DA revision timing does not automatically match the central schedule.
UPSC Civil Services Examination
Recent cycles have drawn well over 10 lakh applicants competing for roughly 800-1,000 posts across IAS, IPS, IFoS, and allied central services, a selection rate commonly cited near 0.1%.
State PSC exams (state civil service)

Applicant volume swings hard by state. Smaller and mid-size states commonly see 1-3 lakh applicants for a few hundred posts. UP and Bihar sit at the other extreme, UPPSC and BPSC routinely draw applicant numbers that rival UPSC in scale, because both states have large populations and multiple concurrent recruitment cycles.
SSC CGL and other central Group B/C exams
SSC CGL alone routinely draws 25-40 lakh applicants nationwide for a much wider vacancy pool spread across dozens of central departments, because the same exam feeds many different postings at once.
